content: अर्वाच् {%a.%} [अवरे काले देशे वा अञ्चति पृषो˚ अर्वादेशः] .²1 Coming hitherward (<ab>opp.</ab> पराञ्च्). .²2 Turned towards, coming to meet anyone. .²3 Being on this side (as the bank of a river); (<ab>opp.</ab> पर). .²4 Being below or behind (in time or place). .²5 Following, subsequent. .{@-क्@} {%ind.%} .²1 Hitherward, on this side. .²2 From a certain point. .²3 Before (in time or place); यत्सृष्टेरर्वाक् सलिलमयं ब्रह्माण्डमभूत् <ls>K. 125</ls>; अर्वाक् संवत्सरात्स्वामी हरेत परतो नृपः <ls>Y. 2. 173</ls>, <ls n="Y. 2.">113</ls>, <ls n="Y.">1. 254</ls>; <ls>Ms. 8. 30</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">5. 59</ls>. .²4 On the lower side, behind, downwards (<ab>opp.</ab> ऊर्ध्वम्). .²5 Afterwards, subsequently. .²6 (With <ab>loc.</ab>) Within, near; एते चार्वागुपवनभुवि छिन्नदर्भाङ्कुरायाम् <ls>Ś. 1. 15</ls>.
